title: Everything Ingots
description: I made ingots for stuffs that arent supposed to have ingots.
body:
Ever wanted to see what happens if you could smelt diamonds or coal with coal? Today, I added that to Minecraft. Download Everything Ingots now to experience the ultimate INGOTVENGERS experience.

## Newest Ingots/Update Log:
- Redstone Ingot
- Smelted Iron Ingot
- Smelted Redstone Ingot
- Fixed some advancement bugs (not getting an advancement when you get more than 1 ingot/smelted ingot)

[![Available For NeoForge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9ae07fbc26c08220b4856cb244f86904d0c172c.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/everything-ingots/versions?l=neoforge)

<details>
<summary>Ingots</summary>

- Diamond Ingot
- Coal Ingot
- Emerald Ingot
- Redstone Ingot

Smelted Ingots:
- Smelted Diamond Ingot
- Smelted Coal Ingot
- Smelted Gold Ingot
- Smelted Emerald Ingot
- Smelted Redstone Ingot
- Smelted Iron Ingot

</details>

<details>
<summary>To Add List</summary>

- Ruby Ingots

</details>
